character.description: A hand-drawn effects animation test focused on a compact smoke-and-sparks burst, with no character required
character.build: clear layered smoke silhouette with readable outer contour

style.name: late-1980s-early-1990s-hand-painted-cel-effects
style.description: Original hand-drawn cel-animation effects art with painted acetate-era shading, graphic smoke shapes, restrained airbrush bloom, inked contours and photographed-cel texture; evoke the craft and production qualities of late-1980s and early-1990s theatrical science-fiction animation without copying any specific film, studio, character or shot
style.medium: inked animation drawing with hand-painted cel colour and photographed-film texture
style.period: late 1980s to early 1990s animation production aesthetics
style.lighting: brief warm internal flash fading into cooler painted smoke volumes
mustHave: clearly illustrated rather than simulated particles

continuity_locks: keep the effect entirely 2D and hand-drawn in appearance

shots.description: A single original hand-painted 2D effects keyframe: a compact ground-level smoke burst with a few glowing sparks and a fading inner flash, designed as animation production art rather than a particle simulation
shots.pose: asymmetric layered smoke puffs expanding outward with directional energy
shots.camera: straight-on effects plate, no perspective-heavy environment
shots.background: simple dark neutral animation-stage background that clearly separates the drawn effect
shots.framing: effect centered with generous clean margin
